description_en: Lists all client certificates and server certificates issued by a private certificate authority (CA)
description_zh: 查询所有客户端证书和服务端证书的详细信息
name: ListClientCertificate

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页显示证书的数量。默认值为20
parameters.name: show_size

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the client or server-side certificate that you want to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330884.html to query the unique identifiers of all client and server-side certificates
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的客户端证书或服务端证书的唯一识别码。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330884.html查询所有客户端证书和服务端证书的唯一识别码
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2716559.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2716559.html接口获取
parameters.name: resource_group_id

CertificateList.description_en: A list of details about the client or server-side certificates
CertificateList.description_zh: 客户端证书或服务端证书的详情列表

AfterDate.description_en: The expiration date of the certificate. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
AfterDate.description_zh: 证书的到期日期。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

Algorithm.description_en:
The type of the encryption algorithm of the certificate. Valid values:

RSA: RSA algorithm.

ECC: ECC algorithm.

SM2: SM2 algorithm
Algorithm.description_zh:
证书的加密算法类型。取值：

RSA：表示RSA算法。
ECC：表示ECC算法。
SM2：表示SM2（国密）算法

AliasName.description_en: The name of the issued certificate

BeforeDate.description_en: The issuance date of the certificate. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
BeforeDate.description_zh: 证书的签发日期。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

CertificateType.description_en:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

CLIENT: a client certificate.

SERVER: a server-side certificate
CertificateType.description_zh:
证书的类型。取值：

CLIENT：表示客户端证书。
SERVER：表示服务端证书

CommonName.description_en: The common name of the certificate

CountryCode.description_en:
The country code of the country where the organization associated with the issuing subordinate CA certificate is located.

For more information about country codes, see the Country codes section of [Manage company information]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html）
CountryCode.description_zh:
签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在国家的代码。

关于不同国家代码的含义，请参见[管理公司信息]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html）中的**国际代号**章节

CustomIdentifier.description_en: The custom identifier, which is a unique key
CustomIdentifier.description_zh: 用户自定义标识，唯一键

Days.description_en: The validity period of the certificate. Unit: days

Id.description_en: The primary key ID of the certificate

Identifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the certificate

KeySize.description_en: The key length of the certificate

Locality.description_en: The city where the organization associated with the issuing subordinate CA certificate is located
Locality.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在城市的名称

Md5.description_en: The MD5 fingerprint of the certificate

Organization.description_en: The name of the organization that is associated with the issuing subordinate CA certificate
Organization.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构的名称

OrganizationUnit.description_en: The name of the department of the organization that is associated with the issuing subordinate certificate authority (CA) certificate
OrganizationUnit.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构下部门的名称

ParentIdentifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the subordinate CA certificate that issued this certificate
ParentIdentifier.description_zh: 签发该证书的子CA证书的唯一识别码

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the certificate belongs

Sans.description_en:
The Subject Alternative Name (SAN) extension of the certificate. This extension indicates other domain names, IP addresses, and so on that are associated with the certificate.

This parameter is a string that is converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array is a struct that corresponds to a SAN extension. Each SAN extension struct contains the following parameters:

Type: The type of the extension. This parameter is of the Integer type. Valid values:

1: an email address.

2: a domain name.

6: a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI).

7: an IP address.

Value: The content of the extension. This parameter is of the String type
Sans.description_zh:
证书的SAN（Subject Alternative Name）扩展属性，表示证书关联的其他域名、IP地址等。

该参数使用JSON数组转化的字符串表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，对应一个SAN扩展。
每个SAN扩展结构体包含以下参数：

Type：Integer类型，表示扩展的类型。取值：
1：表示邮箱地址。
2：表示域名。
6：表示统一资源标识符URI（Uniform Resource Identifier）。
7：表示IP地址。
Value：String类型，表示扩展的内容

SerialNumber.description_en: The serial number of the certificate

Sha2.description_en: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate

SignAlgorithm.description_en: The signature algorithm of the certificate

State.description_en:
<props="china">The name of the province, municipality, or autonomous region where the organization associated with the issuing subordinate CA certificate is located.</props>
<props="intl">The name of the province or state where the organization associated with the issuing subordinate CA certificate is located.</props>
State.description_zh:
<props="china">签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份、直辖市或自治区的名称。</props>
<props="intl">签发该证书的子CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份或州的名称。</props>

Status.description_en:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:

ISSUE: The certificate is issued.

REVOKE: The certificate is revoked
Status.description_zh:
证书的状态。取值：

ISSUE：表示正常签发。
REVOKE：表示已被吊销

SubjectDN.description_en:
The Distinguished Name (DN) of the certificate. The DN indicates the user of the certificate and contains the following information:

C: The country.

O: The organization.

OU: The department.

L: The city.

<props="china">

ST: The province, municipality, or autonomous region.

</props>


<props="intl">

ST: The province or state.

</props>


CN: The common name
SubjectDN.description_zh:
证书的DN（Distinguished Name）属性，表示证书的使用者，具体包含以下信息：

C：国家。
O：组织机构。
OU：部门。
L：城市。
<props="china">- ST：省份、直辖市或自治区。</props>
<props="intl">- ST：省份或州。</props>
CN：公用名

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned page

MaxResults.description_en: Paging parameter: the maximum number of entries in the result set
MaxResults.description_zh: 分页参数：结果集的最大数量

ShowSize.description_en: The number of certificates returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of client and server-side certificates that are queried
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的客户端证书和服务端证书的总数量
